newsitem.title: USA: Guarantee Life Q4 net up significantly.
newsitem.headline: Guarantee Life Q4 net up significantly.

text.p: Guarantee Life Cos Inc said Wednesday net income for the fourth quarter ended December 31 was six times results one year ago in part because of costs associated with its demutualization in 1995.

The company said net income in the most recent period reached $0.42 a share, compared to $0.07 last year. The year-ago quarter included a loss of $2.6 million from discontinued operations and a $2.7 million provision for mutual company equity add-on taxes, Guarantee Life said.
A spokesman said 1995 results would have totaled between $0.18 and 40.25 a share without the loss and provision.
Guarantee Life is an insurance holding company. Its shares were unchanged Wednesday afternoon at 20-1/8.
